data.research_question: Which public organizations relevant to the anarchist-violence corpus are discoverable from the next unresolved authoritative shard-B U.S. geographic NPAs 712, 715 and 718?
data.method: Recomputed the durable shard-B backlog from current main, admitted only current U.S. geographic NPAs, searched the existing corpus before external discovery, preferred current first-party sources, and created new organization records only after no canonical identity collision was found.
classification_rules: Do not infer individual political affiliation from organization proximity, attendance, public role or area-code locality.
Do not label an organization anarchist absent explicit organization-level self-description.
Treat community support, advocacy, mutual aid and grassroots organizing as source descriptions rather than inferred ideology.
Reuse canonical organization identities when already present; an overlay or new NPA is not a new organization.
Treat public organizational contacts only as organization-level evidence and do not enrich private-person data.

findings.notes: Support Siouxland Soldiers has a current first-party Sioux City 2026 calendar and community-support programs; no political label is inferred.
Power Up Eau Claire has a current first-party Eau Claire surface describing grassroots organizing, community care, mutual-aid efforts and rapid-response support.
Bed-Stuy Strong has a current first-party Bedford-Stuyvesant mutual-aid network surface and current member/resource infrastructure.

gaps: This bounded pass does not exhaust every organization within the three NPA service regions.
No individual affiliation or membership is inferred from organizational discovery.
Follow-on targets remain limited to public organization/project/partner relationships.
